title: Unified Knowledge Map Pattern Library V2
summary: Generic node-card expansion patterns for the v2 cross-disciplinary knowledge map.

patterns.title: Concept Node
patterns.summary: For abstract concepts, categories, and definitions.

sections.title: 定义
sections.prompt: Give a stable definition for this concept in the source learning context.

sections.title: 本质理解
sections.prompt: Explain why this concept matters and how it functions in the larger knowledge structure.

sections.title: 核心要点
sections.prompt: List the key judgment points, features, or conclusions learners must grasp.

sections.title: 典型例子
sections.prompt: List representative examples that help explain the concept.

sections.title: 易混辨析
sections.prompt: List common confusions or non-examples.

expansion_questions: What should a learner be able to distinguish after learning it?
What other concepts does it connect to?

patterns.title: Entity Node
patterns.summary: For substances, organisms, places, people, institutions, and other named objects.

sections.title: 基本身份
sections.prompt: State what kind of entity it is and how it is basically identified.

sections.title: 关键属性
sections.prompt: List the most important stable properties or characteristics.

sections.title: 功能与用途
sections.prompt: Describe key functions, roles, or uses.

sections.title: 检验与区分
sections.prompt: Describe how it is identified, tested, or distinguished when relevant.

expansion_questions: What kind of object is it?
What are its most important properties?
How is it recognized or used?

patterns.title: Process Node
patterns.summary: For change processes, mechanisms, and procedural transformations in the world.

sections.title: 过程描述
sections.prompt: Describe what the process is.

sections.title: 输入与输出
sections.prompt: Describe the inputs, outputs, or before-after states.

sections.title: 条件与影响因素
sections.prompt: Describe conditions, triggers, and influencing factors.

sections.title: 典型现象
sections.prompt: List the observable signs or effects of this process.

expansion_questions: What does the process lead to?

patterns.title: Principle Node
patterns.summary: For laws, rules, mechanisms, and stable explanatory principles.

sections.title: 核心表述
sections.prompt: State the principle or rule clearly.

sections.title: 含义理解
sections.prompt: Explain what the principle means.

sections.title: 应用场景
sections.prompt: List typical contexts where the principle is applied.

sections.title: 适用边界
sections.prompt: State known limits, assumptions, or conditions.

expansion_questions: Under what conditions is it used?

patterns.title: Method Node
patterns.summary: For reusable methods, procedures, and problem-solving approaches.

sections.title: 目标
sections.prompt: State what this method is for.

sections.title: 适用条件
sections.prompt: Describe when the method should be used.

sections.title: 操作步骤
sections.prompt: List the main steps of the method.

sections.title: 常见错误
sections.prompt: List common mistakes or failure modes.

patterns.title: Skill Node

sections.title: 能力定义
sections.prompt: Define the skill in learner-facing terms.

sections.title: 表现指标
sections.prompt: Describe how the skill is demonstrated or assessed.

sections.title: 训练方式
sections.prompt: Describe how the skill is practiced or strengthened.

expansion_questions: What does successful performance look like?

patterns.title: Representation Node
patterns.summary: For symbols, formulas, equations, diagrams, and other formal representations.

sections.title: 表示含义
sections.prompt: Explain what this representation stands for.

sections.title: 读写规则
sections.prompt: Describe how the representation is read, written, or interpreted.

sections.title: 关联对象
sections.prompt: Describe what entities, concepts, or processes it represents.

expansion_questions: How should it be read or written?
What knowledge objects does it connect to?

patterns.title: Activity Node
patterns.summary: For experiments, investigations, and reusable learning or inquiry activities.

sections.title: 活动目标
sections.prompt: State the purpose of the activity.

sections.title: 材料与条件
sections.prompt: Describe the materials, tools, or setup.

sections.title: 实施过程
sections.prompt: List the main steps of the activity.

sections.title: 关键观察
sections.prompt: List the key observations, outputs, or conclusions.

expansion_questions: What is the activity trying to show or achieve?

sections.title: 事件定义
sections.prompt: Define what the event is.

sections.title: 背景
sections.prompt: Describe the event background.

sections.title: 关键因素
sections.prompt: List the major causes, factors, or participants.

sections.title: 影响
sections.prompt: Describe the major consequences or significance.

patterns.title: Issue Node
patterns.summary: For persistent, discussable issues and public-interest topics.

sections.title: 核心定义
sections.prompt: Define the issue clearly.

sections.title: 关键因素
sections.prompt: List the main causes, drivers, or dimensions.

sections.title: 影响
sections.prompt: Describe the main consequences or significance.

sections.title: 应对思路
sections.prompt: List possible responses, viewpoints, or mitigation paths.
